topic: Session calibration and data processing updates
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered technical details regarding session calibration for Spain, specifically addressing the use of `device_session_calibration_staging` data rather than relying solely on the `is_calibrated` flag in `device_session_concept`. A code snippet was shared illustrating how to pull staging calibration data.

Later, a request was made to run all models for the period from February 19th until the end of the month within `ml_staging`. The participant confirmed running a query on the stage table (`allunite.device_session_agg_ml_staging`) filtered between '2022-02-19' and '2022-03-01'. It was noted that this staging data contained new impressions only for Finland, but it is intended for testing purposes.
decisions: The team agreed to use the `device_session_calibration_staging` table directly for calibration data when processing sessions for Spain.
action_items: Run all models in ml_staging for the period starting February 19th until the end of the month.
